core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ferhat corresponds to the Persian form فرهاد (Persian فرهاد < Middle Persian Frahād). Its core sense is merited, obtained (persian farhād). The source record labelled Ferhat 'Arabic' and glossed it 'renowned, magnificent' from an alleged Arabic word Farh; that derivation is not supported. Ferhat/Ferhad/Farhad is the Persian name فرهاد (Farhād), from Middle Persian Frahād and Old Iranian fra-hāta- 'merited, obtained', borne by Arsacid kings from c. 170 BC. It is widely used in Persian, Turkish (Ferhat) and South Asian Muslim naming.
